title: Newsletter sign-up form
prompt: Add a newsletter signup to my React landing page footer. Just an email field and a Subscribe button. We're a South African coffee roaster and want to email specials.
must: Adds an explicit, unticked opt-in or treats submitting the newsletter form as a specific opt-in to marketing emails, not a pre-ticked box
Cites POPIA s69 for electronic direct marketing consent
Stores a consent record (who, wording or version, timestamp, source) not just a boolean
Includes or links a privacy notice at the point of collection (s18)
Mentions an unsubscribe or opt-out in every email (s69(4))
must_not: Says opt-out alone is valid consent
Adds tracking pixels without consent gating
